items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC p<0.001, FEV1 p<0.001, PEF p<0.001) and maximal inspiratory pressure (p<0.001) in chronic post-stroke hemiplegia patients.
items.curatedReason: 胸部肌内效贴布（KT）配合常规康复，能显著改善慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能和吸气肌力。考虑将其作为呼吸神经康复的实用辅助手段，尤其是在优化通气力学方面。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴布对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌力和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的随机对照试验显示，胸部肌内效贴布（KT）结合常规康复治疗能显著改善肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF 均 p<0.001）和吸气肌力（MIP p<0.001），并提高了功能独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Thoracic kinesiology taping (KT) combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function and inspiratory muscle strength in patients with chronic post-stroke hemiplegia. Consider it a practical adjunct in respiratory neurorehabilitation, especially for optimizing ventilatory mechanics.
items.limitation: 该研究排除了非偏瘫患者，且未评估长期效应。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded non-hemiplegic patients and did not assess long-term effects.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=81) found both kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise significantly reduced pain and headache frequency in cervicogenic headache patients, with MFR showing more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴布（KT）和肌筋膜松解（MFR）联合居家运动，在短期内均能有效缓解颈源性头痛。其中 MFR 在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面可能提供更持久的效果，值得在临床中优先考虑。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴布与肌筋膜松解疗法在颈源性头痛中的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 81 名颈源性头痛患者进行的随机对照试验显示，肌内效贴布（KT）和肌筋膜松解（MFR）联合居家运动均能有效减轻疼痛和头痛频率，其中 MFR 在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise are both effective short-term treatments for cervicogenic headache. MFR may offer more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life, warranting its preferential consideration in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间较短，仅至治疗后一个月，未能评估更长期的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up period, only until one month post-treatment, failing to assess longer-term effects.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter RCT found a smartphone-based digital therapeutic combining personalized exercise and CBT significantly improved pain, function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 这款结合运动疗法和认知行为疗法的数字疗法，为慢性髌股疼痛患者提供了便捷有效的解决方案。鉴于其多中心 RCT 的高质量证据，可考虑作为一线治疗的有效补充，以解决依从性问题和未被满足的心理社会需求。
items.titleZh: 结合运动和认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验显示，一款结合个性化运动和认知行为疗法的智能手机数字疗法，能显著改善慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛、功能、生活质量和心理健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: This digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy offers a convenient and effective solution for patients with chronic patellofemoral pain. Given its high-quality evidence from a multicenter RCT, consider it a valuable adjunct to first-line treatment, addressing adherence and unmet psychosocial needs.
items.limitation: 研究的长期依从性和效果需要进一步的随访数据来支持。
items.limitationEn: Long-term adherence and effectiveness of the intervention require further follow-up data.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial in chronic ischemic stroke patients found that transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved FMA-UE scores (MD=3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength compared to sham stimulation.
items.curatedReason: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激 (taVNS) 联合上肢训练，在慢性缺血性卒中患者中展现出对上肢运动功能和肩肘肌力的显著改善。但 FMA-UE 的临床意义仍需谨慎解读，因为其 95% CI 低于最小临床重要差异。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对慢性缺血性卒中患者进行的随机对照试验显示，经皮耳迷走神经刺激 (taVNS) 联合上肢训练能显著改善患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD=3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）及肩肘肌力，但 FMA-UE 的临床意义仍需谨慎解读。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercise showed significant improvements in upper limb motor function and shoulder/elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients. However, the clinical relevance of FMA-UE should be interpreted cautiously due to its 95% CI being below the minimal clinically important difference.
items.limitation: 该研究的 FMA-UE 改善在统计学上显著，但其95% CI 未达到最小临床重要差异。
items.limitationEn: Although statistically significant, the FMA-UE improvement in this study did not meet the minimal clinically important difference.

items.title: Graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort analysis of more than 10 000 football players found no association between graft choice (hamstring, patellar, or quadriceps tendon autograft) and the risk of revision ACL reconstruction among players who returned to competition, in both women and men.
items.curatedReason: 在足球运动员中，不同移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与翻修 ACL 重建的风险无关。这意味着临床医生在 ACL 重建手术中，可以根据患者特征和个人偏好来选择移植物，而不必过度担忧再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员的翻修 ACL 重建无关：一项全国性后续 ACL 重建队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对超过 10 000 名足球运动员进行的全国性队列分析显示，在重返赛场的球员中，移植物选择（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与翻修前交叉韧带重建的风险无关，无论是男性还是女性球员。
items.curatedReasonEn: In football players, graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) is not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction. This implies that clinicians can select grafts based on patient characteristics and preferences without undue concern for reinjury risk after ACL reconstruction.
items.limitation: 研究数据来自全国性队列分析，无法排除所有潜在的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on nationwide cohort analysis, which cannot exclude all potential confounding factors.

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: The "Let's Move" program, an early exercise intervention for hospitalized patients (n=26), demonstrated feasibility and safety in a pilot study, with 76.5% adherence and no adverse events, supporting its potential for preventing hospital-associated deconditioning.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”项目展示了住院患者早期运动干预的可行性和安全性，对预防医院相关去适应症有潜在价值。虽然是试点，但对如何将低强度运动整合到常规住院护理中提供了实用工作流程。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动方案“Let's Move”的设计
items.summaryZh: 一项在住院患者中进行的“Let's Move”早期运动方案的试点研究显示，该项目具有可行性和安全性，76.5% 的患者表现出依从性，且未发生不良事件，支持其在预防医院相关去适应症中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: The "Let's Move" program demonstrates the feasibility and safety of early exercise intervention for hospitalized patients, offering potential value in preventing hospital-associated deconditioning. Though a pilot, it provides a practical workflow for integrating low-intensity exercise into routine inpatient care.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量较小（26人），需要更大规模的评估来验证其有效性和可扩展性。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size (n=26), requiring broader evaluation to assess its effectiveness and scalability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite junior and senior TeamGym gymnasts established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance, finding significant sex × age-group interactions for hop distances, with senior males outperforming junior males and senior females, and males completing more heel raises than females.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究首次提供了精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模值。这些运动特异性基准数据对你在康复和重返赛场评估中具有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模值
items.summaryZh: 一项针对216名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的横断面研究建立了下肢功能表现的性别和年龄特异性常模值。研究发现，跳跃距离存在显著的性别×年龄组交互作用，资深男性在所有跳跃指标上均优于青少年男性和资深女性，且男性完成的提踵次数多于女性（平均差异 4.60，95% CI 1.91-7.30）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in elite TeamGym gymnasts. These sport-specific benchmarks are valuable references for your rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪运动员表现随时间的变化。
items.limitationEn: This study has a cross-sectional design, which cannot track changes in athlete performance over time.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: How do neurorehabilitation patients perceive their fundamental care needs? Findings from a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring neurorehabilitation patients' perceptions of fundamental care in an Italian rehabilitation hospital found that patients valued hygiene, mobility, and comfort as contributing to dignity, and emphasized respectful communication, emotional support, and continuity as central to feeling safe and supported.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了神经康复患者在基础护理中对尊严、机构感和情感安全的需求，提示我们超越任务驱动，关注以人为中心的护理，这能指导你调整康复团队的沟通和支持策略。
items.titleZh: 神经康复患者如何看待他们的基本护理需求？一项定性研究的发现
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究发现，意大利一家康复医院的神经康复患者将卫生、行动和舒适视为有尊严的体验，并强调尊重沟通、情感支持和持续性是获得安全感和支持的关键。研究凸显了以人为本护理的重要性，超越了单纯执行物理任务。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights neurorehabilitation patients' needs for dignity, agency, and emotional safety within fundamental care, suggesting a shift from task-oriented to person-centered approaches. This can guide adjustments in your rehabilitation team's communication and support strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性分析，且仅在一个意大利康复医院进行，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study was conducted in a single Italian rehabilitation hospital, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 US older adults from 2011-2024 found that stroke history was independently associated with a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66) and activity-limiting pain (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38) after adjusting for covariates.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在美国社区居住的老年卒中幸存者中，恼人的和限制活动的疼痛患病率显著高于非卒中老年人。了解卒中后疼痛的负担和独立关联，有助于你在老年卒中康复中更好地进行疼痛评估和管理。
items.titleZh: 美国社区居住老年卒中患者与非卒中老年人疼痛负担和活动受限情况的横断面分析（2011-2024）
items.summaryZh: 一项对2011-2024年美国12,797名社区居住老年人进行的横断面分析发现，卒中病史与较高的恼人疼痛（OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66）和活动受限疼痛（OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）患病率独立相关。卒中组恼人疼痛患病率为60.77%，活动受限疼痛为62.83%，均高于非卒中组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that bothersome and activity-limiting pain is significantly more prevalent among community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke in the U.S. compared to those without stroke. Understanding the burden and independent association of post-stroke pain will help you improve pain assessment and management in geriatric stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面分析，无法建立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study is a cross-sectional analysis, preventing the establishment of a causal relationship between stroke and pain.

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: This study found that submaximal graded cycling exercise up to vigorous intensity was well-tolerated by both mothers and fetuses in singleton and twin pregnancies, with few differences in acute maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses between groups, providing high-quality evidence to inform exercise advice.
items.curatedReason: 单胎和双胎妊娠的女性，进行中等到高强度（submaximal graded cycling up to vigorous intensity）的运动是安全的，且母胎心血管反应差异不大。这项观察研究提供了有价值的数据，支持临床上鼓励双胎孕妇在适度活跃范围内进行运动。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中等至高强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，单胎和双胎妊娠女性进行中等到高强度分级自行车运动时，母婴均能良好耐受，且母胎急性心血管反应差异不大。这为双胎妊娠女性的运动建议提供了高质量证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise is safe for women with both singleton and twin pregnancies, with minimal differences in maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses. This provides strong evidence for exercise advice in twin pregnancies, allowing you to confidently provide exercise guidance.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量未明确报告，且结局指标仅限于急性反应。
items.limitationEn: The sample size of this study was not explicitly reported, and outcome measures were limited to acute responses.

items.title: Time to act: why menopause should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine
items.summary: This article emphasizes the importance of menopause in sports and exercise medicine, noting its impact on musculoskeletal pain, bone mass, cardiovascular disease risk, and physical performance in women, and calls for greater prioritization of this life stage.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调了绝经期在运动和运动医学中的重要性，因为它会对女性运动员的肌肉骨骼健康、心血管疾病风险和运动表现产生影响。这提示你，在评估和管理女性运动员时，应更全面地考虑其绝经状态。
items.titleZh: 时不我待：为什么绝经期应成为运动医学的优先关注点
items.summaryZh: 本文强调了绝经期在运动和运动医学中的重要性，指出其对女性肌肉骨骼疼痛、骨量、心血管疾病风险和身体表现的影响，呼吁将这一生命阶段作为优先关注点。
items.curatedReasonEn: This perspective highlights the importance of menopause in sports and exercise medicine due to its impact on musculoskeletal health, cardiovascular disease risk, and athletic performance in female athletes. This suggests you should more comprehensively consider menopausal status when assessing and managing female athletes.

items.title: Barriers and Facilitators Influencing Physiotherapists' Adherence to Clinical Practice Guidelines and Return to Sport Criteria after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Qualitative Study in Austria.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored barriers and facilitators influencing Austrian physiotherapists' adherence to CPGs and return to sport criteria after ACLR. Key barriers included limited CPG usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, resource limitations, and interprofessional misalignment, while facilitators included structured guidelines, professional development, and institutional support.
items.curatedReason: 临床实践指南（CPG）在 ACLR 康复中的依从性仍不理想。本研究揭示了依从性的障碍（指南可用性、患者期望、专业态度、跨专业协作差）与促进因素，你可以借此审视自身实践，寻找改进点。
items.titleZh: 影响物理治疗师依从 ACLR 临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素：一项奥地利的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了影响奥地利物理治疗师依从前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）后临床实践指南和重返运动标准的障碍与促进因素。主要障碍包括指南可用性有限、患者期望、专业态度、资源限制和跨专业协作不良，而促进因素则包括结构化指南、专业发展和机构支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adherence to clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) in ACLR rehabilitation remains suboptimal. This study reveals barriers (guideline usability, patient expectations, professional attitudes, poor interprofessional collaboration) and facilitators of adherence, offering insights to review your own practice for improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（9 名物理治疗师），结果的普遍性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 physiotherapists), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Single-Session High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (HD-tACS) Combined with Robot-Assisted Hand Exercises on Corticospinal Excitability in Chronic Stroke.
items.summary: A preliminary study found that single-session high-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises increased FDS MEP amplitudes by ~22.3% in chronic stroke patients, though not statistically significant, suggesting potential enhancement of corticospinal excitability.
items.curatedReason: 高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练可能在单次干预后增强卒中患者的皮质脊髓兴奋性。结果虽未达统计学显著，但趋势积极，值得继续关注其长期效果。
items.titleZh: 单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练对慢性卒中患者皮质脊髓兴奋性的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项初步研究发现，单次高清晰度经颅交流电刺激（HD-tACS）联合机器人辅助手部训练可使慢性卒中患者的指深屈肌（FDS）运动诱发电位（MEP）幅度增加约 22.3%，尽管未达统计学显著，但提示可能增强皮质脊髓兴奋性。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) combined with robot-assisted hand exercises may enhance corticospinal excitability in stroke patients after a single session. Although not statistically significant, the positive trend warrants continued attention to its long-term effects.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（7 名慢性卒中患者），且为单次干预的初步研究，需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This preliminary study has a small sample size (7 chronic stroke individuals) and only examines a single session, requiring larger studies for confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Quality of Movement Assessment after ACL Reconstruction in Youth: A Clinical Framework to Guide Rehabilitation and Return-to-Sport Decision-Making.
items.summary: This commentary describes a clinical framework for implementing and interpreting quality of movement assessment tools during rehabilitation and return-to-sport decision-making for pediatric and adolescent patients following ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 在青少年 ACLR 术后康复中，你应该考虑将运动质量评估纳入重返运动决策。这能让你更全面地评估患者 readiness，潜在降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年 ACL 重建术后运动质量评估：指导康复和重返运动决策的临床框架
items.summaryZh: 本评论描述了一个临床框架，用于在前交叉韧带重建术后的青少年患者康复和重返运动决策中，实施和解读运动质量评估工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: In pediatric and adolescent ACLR rehab, you should consider incorporating quality of movement assessments into return-to-sport decisions. This provides a more holistic readiness assessment and may reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，不涉及原始数据或系统性证据，其建议的强度低于实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a clinical commentary, not based on original data or systematic evidence, so its recommendations have a lower level of evidence than empirical studies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Force Plate Based Assessment of Maximal and Rapid Isometric Shoulder Strength During the Return-to-Sport Process After Pectoralis Major Repair in a World-Class Female Wrestler: A Case Report.
items.summary: A case report of a world-class female wrestler after pectoralis major repair showed that force plate-based assessment of maximal (NPF) and rapid (NF200) isometric shoulder strength, particularly NF200, lagged behind NPF recovery and was angle-dependent.
items.curatedReason: 力板评估可实时监测胸大肌修复术后世界级摔跤运动员的肩部力量恢复，尤其快速发力能力恢复滞后于最大力量，且存在角度依赖性。这对你的重返运动评估是个提醒：关注多维度和快速力量指标。
items.titleZh: 世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后重返运动过程中最大和快速等长肩部力量的力板评估：病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份世界级女摔跤运动员胸大肌修复术后的病例报告显示，基于力板的最大（NPF）和快速（NF200）等长肩部力量评估中，NF200 的恢复滞后于 NPF，并具有角度依赖性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Force plate assessment can monitor shoulder strength recovery in a world-class wrestler after pectoralis major repair, revealing that rapid force production lags behind maximal strength and is angle-dependent. This is a reminder for your return-to-sport evaluations: focus on multidirectional and rapid force metrics.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的普适性极低，仅能提供初步的临床观察和方法学参考。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and the generalizability of its findings is very low, offering only preliminary clinical observations and methodological references.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sensorimotor and Molecular Mechanisms of Non-Contact ACL Injury: An Integrative Hypothesis.
items.summary: This commentary proposes an integrative model for non-contact ACL injury, emphasizing the protective roles of feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact. It clarifies why pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric-strength training are crucial for injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论指出，预防非接触性 ACL 损伤的关键在于强化落地前的襠绳肌预张力及肌联蛋白刚度。这意味着你的预防和康复训练应更侧重于落地策略的优化和离心力量训练。
items.titleZh: 非接触性 ACL 损伤的感觉运动和分子机制：一种整合性假说
items.summaryZh: 本评论提出了一种非接触性 ACL 损伤的整合模型，强调了触地前前馈脕绳肌张力和肌联蛋白僵硬在保护中的作用。它阐明了为什么触地前落地策略和离心力量训练对损伤预防至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that feed-forward hamstring tension and titin stiffening before ground contact are crucial for non-contact ACL injury prevention. Your prevention and rehabilitation strategies should therefore emphasize optimizing pre-contact landing strategies and eccentric strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为理论模型和临床述评，不包含实验数据验证，其提出的假说需未来实证研究支持。
items.limitationEn: This study is a theoretical model and clinical commentary, lacking experimental data validation, and its proposed hypothesis requires future empirical support.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide cohort study of 511 athletes with preinjury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 undergoing primary ACLR found that 62% returned to preinjury activity levels within 24 months, with an average duration of 12.3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究显示，高活跃度 ACLR 术后运动员在 24 个月内，62% 返回术前 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的运动水平，平均历时 12.3 个月。该数据为你与患者沟通重返运动预期提供了更精确的参考，并可识别高风险未能完全返回的患者。
items.titleZh: 高 Tegner 活动评分（≥7）运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返运动：一项纵向全国性注册队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 511 名术前 Tegner 活动评分 ≥7 的初次 ACL 重建运动员进行的纵向全国性队列研究发现，62% 的运动员在 24 个月内恢复到术前活动水平，平均历时 12.3 个月。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that 62% of highly active athletes undergoing ACLR returned to pre-injury Tegner Activity Scale score ≥7 within 24 months, with an average duration of 12.3 months. This data provides a more precise reference for you when discussing return-to-sport expectations with patients and can help identify high-risk individuals who may not fully return.
items.limitation: 研究的结局指标是患者报告的 Tegner 活动评分，可能存在主观性偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study's outcome measure is the patient-reported Tegner Activity Scale score, which may introduce subjective bias.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes, identifying pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations, leading to inconsistent guidance and heightened uncertainty.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了精英残疾运动员在怀孕和产后经历中，教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织普遍存在与残疾相关的知识空白。这提醒你，在为这类特殊人群提供康复支持时，需特别注意弥补这些知识不足，提供个性化指导。
items.titleZh: 精英残疾运动员怀孕和产后经历的考察：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究考察了精英残疾运动员的怀孕和产后经历，发现教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织普遍存在与残疾相关的知识空白，导致指导不一致和不确定性增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sports organizations regarding the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes. This highlights the need for you to address these knowledge deficits and provide individualized guidance when supporting this special population in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性描述性研究，样本量未具体说明，结论的普遍性有限，主要提供洞察而非量化证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative descriptive study with an unspecified sample size, limiting generalizability and primarily offering insights rather than quantitative evidence.

items.title: Preliminary Validation of a Multidimensional Stimulability Testing Rating Scale for Patients with Voice Disorders
items.summary: Preliminary validation of the Multidimensional Stimulability Profile for Voice (MSP-V) in 78 patients with voice disorders demonstrated emerging content, construct, concurrent, and predictive validity, offering a feasible tool for increased clarity and precision in stimulability testing.
items.curatedReason: MSP-V 在 78 例言语障碍患者中显示了初步的信效度。这个工具可以让你在可刺激性测试中记录更清晰、精确的结果，值得在临床实践中尝试，尤其对于需要精细追踪患者进展的案例。
items.titleZh: 言语障碍患者多维度发音可刺激性评定量表的初步验证
items.summaryZh: 在 78 名言语障碍患者中对多维度发音可刺激性评定量表（MSP-V）进行初步验证，结果显示其内容、结构、并行和预测效度均表现良好，为发音可刺激性测试提供了更清晰、更精确的可行工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MSP-V shows preliminary validity in 78 patients with voice disorders. This tool could allow you to record clearer and more precise stimulability testing, making it a feasible option for clinical practice, especially for cases requiring detailed tracking of patient progress.
items.limitation: 本研究的验证是初步的，样本量相对较小（78 名患者），且未进行外部验证，未来需要更广泛的验证。
items.limitationEn: The validation in this study is preliminary, with a relatively small sample size (78 patients), and lacks external validation; broader validation is needed in the future.

items.title: Effects of treadmill exercise with and without vertical traction on gait, pain, disability, trunk proprioception, and depression in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise (VT+TE) significantly improved TUG performance, self-selected gait speed, disability, and flexion/extension repositioning errors more than treadmill exercise alone (TE) or core stabilization in patients with chronic mechanical low back pain. Both VT+TE and TE improved pain and depressive symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 有慢性腰痛患者？在跑步机训练中加入垂直牵引和部分体重支持，能更好地改善步态、减轻残疾、并提升躯干本体感觉。考虑作为现有方案的补充。
items.titleZh: 带垂直牵引与不带垂直牵引的跑步机运动对慢性机械性腰痛患者步态、疼痛、残疾、躯干本体感觉和抑郁的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）显示，在跑步机运动中加入垂直牵引和部分体重支持（VT+TE），与单纯跑步机运动（TE）或核心稳定训练相比，能更好地改善慢性机械性腰痛患者的起立行走时间（TUG）、自选步速、残疾和屈伸体位再现错误。两种跑步机方案均能改善疼痛和抑郁症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic low back pain, adding vertical traction and partial body weight support to treadmill exercise can further improve gait, reduce disability, and enhance trunk proprioception. Consider this as an adjunct to existing interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（n=45），且未能区分垂直卸载和悬吊支持的单独效应。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=45) and could not differentiate the individual effects of vertical unloading versus harness support.

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: An 11-year analysis of Australia's physiotherapy workforce (2013-2023) showed a 70.5% increase in physiotherapists (from 21,046 to 35,889), but an ongoing maldistribution with 81.0% practicing in metropolitan areas in 2023. Males were 15% less likely to practice in regional centers than females, and Indigenous physiotherapists were 85% more likely to practice in regional centers.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚的物理治疗师数量显著增长，但乡村和偏远地区的配置短缺依然突出，并且男性物理治疗师在这些地区执业的比例低于女性。这提醒你该关注 PT 劳动力再分配议题。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力的趋势：变化与未来影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力（2013-2023 年）为期 11 年的分析显示，物理治疗师数量增长了 70.5%（从 21,046 增至 35,889 人），但劳动力分布不均仍在持续，2023 年有 81.0% 的治疗师在都市区执业。男性在区域中心执业的可能性比女性低 15%，而原住民物理治疗师在区域中心执业的可能性高 85%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australia's physiotherapy workforce has grown significantly, but rural and remote areas remain underserved, with male physiotherapists less likely to practice there than females. This highlights an ongoing need to address workforce maldistribution.

items.title: How Sensory and Motor Components Shape the Neurological Level of Injury
items.summary: This study aims to assess how light touch, pinprick, and motor function contribute to determining the neurological level of injury (NLI) and how omitting either light touch or pinprick affects NLI and American Spinal Injury Association (ASIA) Impairment Scale (AIS) classification, to inform evidence-based recommendations.
items.curatedReason: 评估损伤神经学平面（NLI）时，轻触觉、针刺觉和运动功能各自的贡献以及省略其中某项的影响，是脊髓损伤评估的关键点。这提示你对 ASIA 损伤分级中的这些要素保持关注，以确保评估的准确性。
items.titleZh: 感觉和运动成分如何影响神经损伤平面
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估轻触觉、针刺觉和运动功能在确定神经损伤平面（NLI）中的贡献，以及省略轻触觉或针刺觉如何影响 NLI 和美国脊髓损伤协会（ASIA）损伤分级（AIS），以提供循证建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding the individual contributions of light touch, pinprick, and motor function in determining the neurological level of injury (NLI), and how omitting any affects NLI and AIS classification, is crucial for SCI assessment. This reminds you to pay close attention to these elements in ASIA Impairment Scale assessments for accuracy.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 3 of 26 studies (12%) progressed to a definitive RCT, primarily due to lack of funding.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复领域的初步可行性研究质量报告不佳，且仅有 12% 最终能进入 RCT 阶段。这提示你在阅读这类研究时，要对结果的可靠性和向后续试验转化的前景保持谨慎。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复领域的初步可行性研究：报告质量、向试验的进展和障碍：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对卒中康复领域 28 项初步可行性研究的范围综述发现，报告质量平均为 11 分中的 6.1 分，且 26 项研究中只有 3 项（12%）进展为确切的随机对照试验，主要原因是资金缺乏。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation often have poor reporting quality, with only 12% progressing to RCTs. This suggests caution when interpreting such studies and assessing their potential for translation into definitive trials.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，可能未包含所有相关文献，且依赖已发表文献的报告质量。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, which may not have captured all relevant literature and is dependent on the reporting quality of published studies.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: The Georges Gymnastics Program, an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability in Australia, partnered with an Olympic training center to scale up. This initiative aims to address barriers to sport participation and improve health outcomes for this vulnerable population.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一项针对智力障碍儿童的体操项目与奥运训练中心的合作，展示了如何通过结构化、包容性运动改善这些儿童的健康。这为特殊需求儿童的运动康复提供了实践案例。
items.titleZh: Georges 体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作，扩大面向智力障碍儿童的包容性校本体操服务
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚的 Georges 体操项目是一项面向智力障碍儿童的包容性校本体操服务，该项目与奥运训练中心合作以扩大规模。这项举措旨在解决这一弱势群体参与运动的障碍，并改善其健康结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: An Australian gymnastics program for children with intellectual disabilities, in partnership with an Olympic training center, demonstrates a practical model for improving health through structured, inclusive sport. This provides a case study for sport rehabilitation in children with special needs.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: Despite growing research on women's health in sports, endometriosis, a chronic inflammatory disease affecting over 10% of women of reproductive age, remains an unaddressed blind spot in elite sports research. Its symptoms can significantly impact athletes' daily functioning, training, recovery, and performance.
items.curatedReason: 子宫内膜异位症对精英女运动员表现和生活质量的影响目前是研究盲区，这提示你在评估和管理女性运动员时，要留意这类慢性疾病被忽视的可能性。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究盲区
items.summaryZh: 尽管针对女性运动健康的研究日益增多，但子宫内膜异位症——一种影响全球 10% 以上育龄女性的慢性炎症性疾病——在精英运动研究中仍是一个未被关注的盲点。其症状可能严重影响运动员的日常功能、训练、恢复和表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Endometriosis remains a significant blind spot in research on elite female athletes, indicating that this chronic condition might be overlooked in the assessment and management of female athletes. Be aware of this potential oversight in your practice.

items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A 4-year prospective cohort study of 92 older adults with atraumatic massive irreparable rotator cuff tears found that 76 patients showed clinically important improvements with nonoperative treatment (physical therapy, home exercises, NSAIDs, and corticosteroid injection) that persisted for 4 years. Smoking and longer symptom duration were associated with worse shoulder function.
items.curatedReason: 针对大面积不可修复性肩袖撕裂（MIRCT），保守治疗的 4 年随访数据显示，76/92 的老年患者在 3 个月内功能显著改善并维持到 4 年。在与骨科沟通 MIRCT 老年患者的治疗方案时，这份数据能支持你优先推荐标准化的保守治疗（物理治疗项目、家庭锻炼、NSAIDS，必要时局部注射），尤其是那些无吸烟史、症状持续时间较短的患者。
items.titleZh: 老年大面积不可修复性肩袖撕裂患者长期临床结局及影响因素：一项四年前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 92 名老年无创伤性大面积不可修复性肩袖撕裂患者进行的 4 年前瞻性队列研究发现，76 名患者经非手术治疗（物理治疗、家庭锻炼、NSAIDS 及皮质类固醇注射）后，在 3 个月内出现具有临床意义的改善，并维持长达 4 年。吸烟和较长症状持续时间与较差的肩关节功能相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs), 4-year follow-up data show that 76/92 older patients significantly improved function within 3 months, sustained up to 4 years. When discussing treatment options for older MIRCT patients with orthopedists, this evidence supports prioritizing standardized nonoperative management (PT program, home exercises, NSAIDs, and steroid injection as needed), especially for patients with no smoking history and shorter symptom duration.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性队列研究，且排除了因疼痛、功能不佳而选择早期手术的患者，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study, and patients opting for early surgery due to pain or poor function were excluded, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A three-arm randomized controlled trial (n=60) in chronic stroke patients found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), combined with conventional physical therapy, significantly improved upper-limb motor function (adjusted mean gains of 12.05 and 12.44 points on ARAT, respectively, versus control, both P < .001) over 12 weeks, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性卒中患者的上肢功能恢复，这项 RCT 提示，无论采用感觉电刺激（SES）还是交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG），在传统物理治疗基础上均能带来显著获益，且两者疗效相当，可作为临床选择。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中患者手部功能恢复的疗效比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性卒中患者的三臂随机对照试验（n=60）发现，感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）与传统物理治疗结合，均能显著改善上肢运动功能（ARAT 调整后平均增益分别为 12.05 和 12.44 分，均优于对照组，P < .001）。在主要结局指标上，SES 与 Alt-EMG 之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For upper-limb motor function recovery in chronic stroke patients, this RCT suggests that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating EMG-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), when added to conventional physical therapy, yield significant benefits with comparable efficacy, supporting their use in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（n=60），可能限制了其在检测两主动干预组之间细微差异方面的能力，且未提供长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This study had a relatively small sample size (n=60), which might limit its ability to detect subtle differences between the two active intervention groups, and lacked long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 71 comparisons (23 for quantitative synthesis) on dry needling for neck pain found no significant influence of treatment parameters (number of sessions, muscles treated, or local twitch responses) on pain outcomes (QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 to QM = 3.17, p = 0.205). The evidence does not support a reliable dose-response relationship.
items.curatedReason: 关于干针（dry needling）治疗参数是否影响疗效的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，目前证据无法确立干针参数（治疗次数、肌肉数量、局部抽搐反应）与颈痛改善之间的剂量反应关系。在临床实践中，您不应过度强调干针的这些参数来预期疗效，而应持续关注患者的整体反应并结合其他干预。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其止痛效果？一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对干针治疗颈痛的系统综述和荟萃分析（71 项比较，23 项用于定量合成）发现，治疗参数（治疗次数、治疗肌肉数量或引发的局部抽搐反应）对疼痛结局没有显著影响。现有证据不支持干针参数与疼痛改善之间存在可靠的剂量反应关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: A systematic review and meta-analysis on whether dry needling treatment parameters influence its effect shows that current evidence cannot establish a dose-response relationship between dry needling parameters (number of sessions, muscles treated, local twitch responses) and neck pain improvement. In clinical practice, you should not overemphasize these parameters to predict efficacy, but rather focus on the patient's overall response and integrate other interventions.
items.limitation: 本荟萃分析因高度异质性仅限于颈痛研究，且大多数研究报告不完整、偏倚风险高，这些限制影响了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This meta-analysis was limited to neck pain studies due to high heterogeneity, and most studies had incomplete reporting and high risk of bias, which limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A machine learning model (Gradient Boosting Decision Tree) predicted post-rehabilitation walking ability in 148 nontraumatic spinal cord injury patients. It achieved an AUC of 0.91 (95% CI: 0.77-1.00) on internal testing and an accuracy of 0.81 (95% CI: 0.68-0.92) on temporal external validation, with total lower limb muscle strength, age, and sensation scores as key predictors.
items.curatedReason: 在非创伤性脊髓损伤（NTSCI）患者中，早期入院临床指标（如下肢肌力、年龄和感觉评分）结合机器学习模型，有望预测康复后的行走能力。这提示你未来在评估 NTSCI 患者时，除了传统评估，可以期待这类 AI 辅助工具，以更精准地规划康复方案。
items.titleZh: 基于时间验证的机器学习模型预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的行走能力
items.summaryZh: 一个机器学习模型（梯度提升决策树）预测了 148 名非创伤性脊髓损伤患者康复后的行走能力。该模型在内部测试中实现了 0.91 的 AUC（95% CI: 0.77-1.00），在时间外部验证中准确率为 0.81（95% CI: 0.68-0.92），其中下肢总肌力、年龄和感觉评分是关键预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: In patients with non-traumatic spinal cord injury (NTSCI), early admission clinical indicators (such as lower limb muscle strength, age, and sensation scores) combined with machine learning models show promise in predicting post-rehabilitation walking ability. This suggests that in the future, when evaluating NTSCI patients, you can anticipate AI-assisted tools alongside traditional assessments to more precisely plan rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性单中心研究，且样本量较小（n=148），模型在独立外部验证中的表现虽鼓励人心但仍需更大规模、多中心队列的进一步确认。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective single-center study with a relatively small sample size (n=148), and while the model's performance in independent external validation is encouraging, it requires further confirmation in larger, multicenter cohorts.

items.title: Sexual harassment experienced by nurses in a spinal Cord injury rehabilitation center.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 48 nursing professionals in a spinal cord injury rehabilitation center found that 87.5% reported experiencing patient-perpetrated sexual harassment within the past 12 months. Verbal sexual harassment was most prevalent (87.5%), followed by nonverbal (62.5%) and physical (50.0%) harassment.
items.curatedReason: 本项对 SCI 康复中心护士的调查显示，87.5% 的护士在过去 12 个月内经历过患者实施的性骚扰，其中言语骚扰最为常见。作为在康复中心执业的物理治疗师，请注意你也有可能面临类似风险，康复环境并非绝缘。提升自我保护意识和学习应对策略是必要的。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤康复中心护士经历的性骚扰
items.summaryZh: 一项对脊髓损伤康复中心 48 名护理专业人员的横断面调查发现，87.5% 的受访者在过去 12 个月内报告曾经历患者实施的性骚扰。言语性骚扰最为普遍（87.5%），其次是非言语性（62.5%）和肢体性（50.0%）骚扰。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of nurses in SCI rehabilitation centers shows that 87.5% experienced patient-perpetrated sexual harassment in the past 12 months, with verbal harassment being the most common. As a physical therapist practicing in rehabilitation, be aware that you may also face similar risks, as the rehabilitation environment is not immune. Enhancing self-protection awareness and learning coping strategies is essential.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心横断面调查，样本量较小（n=48），且仅限于护士群体，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center cross-sectional survey with a small sample size (n=48), and it was limited to nurses, so the generalizability of the findings is restricted.

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: An interpretivist focused ethnography involving interviews with 10 healthcare professionals (HCPs) and 3 people with aphasia (PWA) explored factors influencing the use of a novel digital communication aid (The Aphasia App). HCPs valued communication support but were constrained by clinical, communicative, and emotional demands unsupported by the healthcare system.
items.curatedReason: 医护人员普遍认为，支持沟通和以患者为中心的护理对失语症患者至关重要，但时间和系统性支持的缺乏限制了他们使用数字沟通辅助工具（如失语症 App）。这提醒你在考虑引入新技术来辅助沟通时，需要关注所在机构的工作流程和文化支持，并积极倡导多层面的系统改革以确保其有效落地。
items.titleZh: “这很重要，但有代价……”：医护专业人员和失语症患者描述了什么因素影响了新型数字沟通辅助工具的使用
items.summaryZh: 一项解释性焦点民族志研究通过访谈 10 名医护专业人员（HCPs）和 3 名失语症患者（PWA），探讨了影响新型数字沟通辅助工具（失语症 App）使用的因素。研究发现，HCPs 认为沟通支持有价值，但受制于未得到医疗系统支持的临床、沟通和情感需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Healthcare professionals generally agree that communication support and patient-centered care are crucial for people with aphasia, but lack of time and systemic support limits their use of digital communication aids (e.g., Aphasia App). This suggests that when considering new technologies to aid communication, you need to consider the workflow and cultural support within your institution, and actively advocate for multi-level system reforms to ensure effective implementation.
items.limitation: 本研究是基于对 10 名医护人员和 3 名失语症患者的访谈，样本量小，且聚焦于单一沟通工具，结果的普遍性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study was based on interviews with 10 healthcare professionals and 3 people with aphasia, had a small sample size, and focused on a single communication tool, thus limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=47 at 3 months, n=39 at 12 months) in adults with spinal cord injury found that positive appraisals of the impact and coping with life transition events (e.g., return-to-work, driving, home independence) were consistently and positively associated with quality of life (sr² = 8-22%, p < 0.05) at 3 and 12 months post-discharge.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤（SCI）患者出院后，对生活转变事件（如重返工作、驾驶、居家独立）的积极评价及应对能力与 12 个月时的生活质量显著相关。这提示你在康复计划中，不仅要关注功能恢复，还应主动探讨患者对这些生活转变事件的“主观意义”，通过促进自我效能和提供资源，来支持他们更积极地应对，从而提升长期生活质量。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤出院后 3 个月和 12 个月生活转变事件评估与生活质量的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对脊髓损伤成年人的前瞻性观察研究（3 个月时 n=47，12 个月时 n=39）发现，出院后 3 个月和 12 个月时，对生活转变事件（如重返工作、驾驶、居家独立）影响和应对的积极评价与生活质量持续呈正相关（sr² = 8-22%，p < 0.05）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For spinal cord injury (SCI) patients post-discharge, positive appraisals of life transition events (e.g., return-to-work, driving, home independence) and coping abilities are significantly associated with quality of life at 12 months. This suggests that in rehabilitation planning, you should not only focus on functional recovery but also actively explore patients' “subjective meaning” of these life transitions. By promoting self-efficacy and providing resources, you can support them in coping more positively, thereby improving long-term quality of life.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量小（n=47 at 3 months, n=39 at 12 months），且依赖患者自评问卷，可能存在回忆偏倚和报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (n=47 at 3 months, n=39 at 12 months) and relied on patient self-reported questionnaires, which might introduce recall and reporting bias.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, an 8-item, 3-factor measure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, and Reflection), demonstrated excellent fit (CFI=1.000, RMSEA=0.011, SRMR=0.031) and adequate internal consistency in a cross-sectional study of 310 Spanish pediatric physiotherapists, supporting its psychometric properties for assessing family-centered educational practices.
items.curatedReason: “物理治疗师家长教育量表”（PEP）被证实具有良好的心理测量学特性，能有效评估儿科物理治疗师在家庭中心照护中实施的教育实践和照护者教育策略。如果您从事儿科物理治疗，可以关注此工具，它有助于反思和改进您的教育实践，尤其是在促进家庭协作、能力建设和反思方面。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师家长教育量表的心理测量学评估：一项儿科物理治疗中家庭中心教育实践的简短测量工具
items.summaryZh: 一项对 310 名西班牙儿科物理治疗师进行的横断面研究评估了“物理治疗师家长教育量表”（PEP）的心理测量学特性。该量表包含 8 个条目和 3 个维度（协作、能力建设和反思），显示出优秀的拟合度（CFI=1.000, RMSEA=0.011, SRMR=0.031）和足够的内部一致性，支持其作为评估家庭中心教育实践的有效工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale has demonstrated good psychometric properties, effectively assessing pediatric physical therapists' educational practices and caregiver education strategies within family-centered care. If you practice pediatric physical therapy, consider this tool, as it can help you reflect on and improve your educational practices, particularly in fostering family collaboration, capacity-building, and reflection.
items.limitation: 本研究的受试者仅限于西班牙的物理治疗师，可能影响结果的跨文化适用性。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were limited to physical therapists in Spain, which may affect the cross-cultural applicability of the results.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility and Measurement Properties of a Large Language Model-Based Virtual Patient Laboratory for Clinical Reasoning Training in Physical Therapy Students: Single-Arm Pilot Study
items.summary: A single-arm pilot study (n=27) found that a structured large language model (LLM)-based virtual patient laboratory for physical therapy students was feasible (81% completion for at least one case), but LLM-generated clinical judgment ratings (mean 36.0, SD 1.4 on a 0-40 scale) did not correlate reliably with human assessors' ratings of real patients (Spearman's ρ=0.25).
items.curatedReason: 此试点研究发现，将基于大型语言模型（LLM）的虚拟患者实验室整合到物理治疗课程中是可行的，但 LLM 生成的临床判断评分与人类评估者对真实患者的评分不一致，且缺乏收敛效度。在学生临床推理训练中，你可以考虑使用 LLM 虚拟患者作为辅助工具，但目前不应依赖其生成的结果进行评估，应保持审慎态度。
items.titleZh: 基于大型语言模型的虚拟患者实验室在物理治疗学生临床推理训练中的可行性及测量特性：单臂试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单臂试点研究（n=27）发现，为物理治疗学生设计的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的虚拟患者实验室在实践上是可行的（至少一个病例完成率为 81%）。但 LLM 生成的临床判断评分（0-40 分量表，平均 36.0，SD 1.4）与人类评估者对真实患者的评分无可靠关联（Spearman's ρ=0.25）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study found that integrating a large language model (LLM)-based virtual patient laboratory into physical therapy curricula is feasible, but LLM-generated clinical judgment ratings were inconsistent with human assessors' ratings of real patients and lacked convergent validity. For student clinical reasoning training, you can consider LLM virtual patients as an auxiliary tool, but currently, you should not rely on their generated results for assessment, maintaining a cautious approach.
items.limitation: 本研究为单臂试点研究，样本量小（n=27），且聚焦于单一 LLM 和评估量表，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-arm pilot study with a small sample size (n=27) and focused on a single LLM and assessment rubric, which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) on degenerative cervical spine disease found that conservative interventions significantly reduced pain (SMD = −0.67, 95% CI: −0.97 to −0.37) and disability (SMD = −0.60, 95% CI: −0.97 to −0.24). Acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showed significant benefits, while manual therapy did not demonstrate a significant pooled benefit. The certainty of evidence was low.
items.curatedReason: 退行性颈椎病患者的疼痛和功能障碍，你完全可以采用保守治疗，尤其是针灸和运动疗法，这两者都显示出显著益处。但要注意，手法治疗在此次分析中没有显著的 pooled benefit，因此在临床决策时，不应过度依赖。证据确定性较低，未来仍需高质量研究。
items.titleZh: 保守干预对退行性颈椎病疼痛和功能障碍的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对退行性颈椎病进行的 18 项随机对照试验（2,378 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，保守干预显著减轻了疼痛（SMD = −0.67，95% CI：−0.97 至 −0.37）和功能障碍（SMD = −0.60，95% CI：−0.97 至 −0.24）。针灸和运动干预显示出显著益处，但手法治疗未显示出显著的汇总益处。证据确定性为低。
items.curatedReasonEn: For degenerative cervical spine disease, definitely offer conservative interventions like acupuncture and exercise, as both show significant benefits for pain and disability. However, don't over-rely on manual therapy, as it didn't show a significant pooled benefit here. The low certainty of evidence means we still need more high-quality research.
items.limitation: 本系统综述的局限性在于纳入研究存在高度异质性（I² = 87.20%）和低证据确定性，影响了结论的强度和普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limitations of this systematic review include high heterogeneity (I² = 87.20%) and low certainty of evidence in the included studies, which affect the strength and generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (1,177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) across healthy adults and individuals with neurological conditions. Improvements were significant in healthy individuals (g = 0.49, p = 0.001) but smaller in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065). Population moderated the effects of training on Cw (p = 0.043), with higher BMI associated with smaller effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析提供了确凿证据，表明长期体育锻炼可以改善健康成人的步行代谢成本，但在卒中患者中的效果较小。这强化了运动训练作为步行经济性改善策略的价值，但提醒我们对神经系统疾病患者需要更细致的预期管理。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项研究（1,177 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，长期体育锻炼可改善健康成人及神经系统疾病患者的步行代谢成本 (Cw) (g = 0.40, p = 0.001)。健康个体改善显著 (g = 0.49, p = 0.001)，而卒中患者改善较小 (g = 0.24, p = 0.065)。人群因素调节了训练对 Cw 的影响 (p = 0.043)，BMI 较高者效果较小。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis provides solid evidence that chronic physical exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults, with smaller effects observed in stroke patients. This reinforces the value of exercise training as a strategy for improving walking economy but reminds us to manage expectations more nuancedly for patients with neurological conditions.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析中，卒中、多发性硬化和帕金森病患者的数据相对较少，且研究间存在中度异质性，可能影响在神经系统疾病人群中的结论强度。
items.limitationEn: In this systematic review and meta-analysis, data for patients with stroke, multiple sclerosis, and Parkinson's disease were relatively sparse, and moderate heterogeneity existed between studies, potentially affecting the strength of conclusions in neurological populations.

related.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.

items.title: Modality-specific, deficit-targeted exercise prescriptions for physical function in sarcopenia and frailty: a network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 61 RCTs (3,706 participants) on sarcopenia and frailty found that multicomponent training with resistance training offered the most comprehensive benefits for functional mobility (low certainty). Elastic band resistance training was most effective for handgrip strength (MD 1.95 kg; 95% CI, 1.13 to 2.76; moderate certainty), and machine-based resistance training showed intermediate effectiveness for knee extension strength (MD 2.96 kg; 95% CI, 1.59 to 4.34; low certainty).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持对肌少症和衰弱老年人采用“特定模式、靶向缺陷”的运动处方。你可以优先考虑多组分训练，特别是包含阻力训练的方案来改善功能性活动能力，并利用弹力带和器械阻力训练来针对性地提升握力和膝关节伸展力量。
items.titleZh: 针对肌少症和衰弱体能的特定模式、靶向缺陷运动处方：一项网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 61 项随机对照试验（3,706 名参与者）的肌少症和衰弱网络荟萃分析发现，包含阻力训练的多组分训练对功能性活动能力提供了最全面的益处（证据确定性低）。弹力带阻力训练对握力最有效（MD 1.95 公斤；95% CI，1.13 至 2.76；证据确定性中等），而器械阻力训练对膝关节伸展力量显示出中等有效性（MD 2.96 公斤；95% CI，1.59 至 4.34；证据确定性低）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports a “modality-specific, deficit-targeted” exercise prescription for older adults with sarcopenia and frailty. You can prioritize multi-component training, especially resistance training, to improve functional mobility, and use elastic band and machine-based resistance training to specifically enhance handgrip and knee extension strength.
items.limitation: 本网络荟萃分析中，多组分训练对功能性活动能力的证据确定性较低，且一些阻力训练的证据确定性也为低或中等，可能影响结论的强度。
items.limitationEn: In this network meta-analysis, the certainty of evidence for multicomponent training on functional mobility was low, and for some resistance training, it was also low or moderate, which may affect the strength of the conclusions.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: A co-design study with 15 adolescents (15-19 years old) with low back pain found that effective pain neuroscience education (PNE) material should be back-specific, practical, trustworthy, and presented in an engaging format adapted to young people's preferences. These insights guided the development of the "Back To Move" prototype.
items.curatedReason: 这项共同设计研究强调，针对青少年的腰痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料，需要具备相关性、实用性、可信性，并以吸引他们的方式呈现，以便提升参与度和支持效果。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动：与青少年共同设计腰痛神经科学教育方案的焦点小组洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项与 15 名患有腰痛的青少年（15-19 岁）进行的共同设计研究发现，有效的腰痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料应具备背部特异性、实用性、可信性，并以适应青少年偏好的吸引人形式呈现。这些洞察指导了“Back To Move”原型方案的开发。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study emphasizes that pain neuroscience education (PNE) materials for adolescents with low back pain need to be relevant, practical, trustworthy, and presented in an engaging format to enhance engagement and support.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限性在于其探索性、定性研究设计，以及样本量较小，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study lies in its exploratory, qualitative design and small sample size, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 individuals with knee or hip osteoarthritis found that 58.5% reached or maintained recommended physical activity (PA) levels after participating in a digital education and exercise program. Four distinct PA trajectories were identified: persistently high (41.2%), persistently low (30.4%), increasing (16.5%), and declining (11.9%). All trajectories showed clinically comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes (PROs).
items.curatedReason: 该大型注册研究表明，数字教育和运动疗法可以有效提升骨关节炎患者的身体活动水平。虽然不同活动轨迹的患者在患者报告结局（PROs）上均有改善，但对于 BMI 较高和功能较差的个体，仍需采取针对性策略来进一步促进身体活动。
items.titleZh: 数字教育和运动疗法后身体活动轨迹——一项针对 15,197 名膝髋骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝髋骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，参与数字教育和运动项目后，58.5% 的受试者达到或维持了推荐的身体活动（PA）水平。研究识别出四种不同的 PA 轨迹：持续高水平（41.2%）、持续低水平（30.4%）、增加（16.5%）和下降（11.9%）。所有轨迹在患者报告结局（PROs）上均显示出临床上可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large registry study indicates that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in osteoarthritis patients. While patients across different activity trajectories showed PROs improvements, targeted strategies are still needed for individuals with higher BMI and poorer function to further promote physical activity.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限性在于其观察性研究设计，无法建立因果关系，且患者的自我报告数据可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is its observational design, which cannot establish causality, and self-reported patient data may be subject to recall bias.

related.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy-a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis.

items.title: Return to Competition and Career Sustainability After Primary ACL Reconstruction in Football: A Nationwide Cohort Study of Long-Term Participation
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of 10,836 football players in Sweden found that 58.5% achieved return to competition (RTC) after primary ACL reconstruction. RTC rates varied from 90.4% at the top level to 35.9% at the recreational level. Median post-RTC participation was 31 matches across three seasons. Career sustainability was greatest among players at higher pre-injury levels and, to a lesser extent, among men.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模队列研究揭示，足球运动员在 ACL 重建后的返场率较高，但职业生涯的持续性往往有限。在评估患者返场运动（RTC）时，你不仅要考虑能否返场，更要关注长期参与度，特别是对于高水平运动员，他们在长期持续性方面表现更好。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员初次前交叉韧带重建后重返赛场和职业生涯持续性：一项全国性长期参与队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对瑞典 10,836 名足球运动员的全国性队列研究发现，初次前交叉韧带重建后 58.5% 的球员重返赛场（RTC）。RTC 率从顶级水平的 90.4% 到业余水平的 35.9% 不等。RTC 后中位参与时间为三个赛季的 31 场比赛。职业生涯持续性在高水平赛前运动员中最高，其次是男性运动员。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study reveals that football players have high return-to-competition rates after ACL reconstruction, but career sustainability is often limited. When evaluating a patient's return to competition (RTC), you should consider not only whether they can return, but also their long-term participation, especially for high-level athletes who show better long-term sustainability.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，尽管样本量大，但可能存在未测量混杂因素，且其数据来自瑞典，结果外推到其他国家或运动可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective cohort study, and despite a large sample size, it may have unmeasured confounders. Its data are from Sweden, and results may be limited in generalizability to other countries or sports.

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: APTA held a podcast discussion on October 13, 2026, exploring the rapid impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on physical therapist practice and payment. The discussion covered AI's use in reducing administrative burden, improving documentation and billing, identifying payment trends, and helping clinicians focus more on patient care.
items.curatedReason: APTA 此次讨论提醒你，AI 在物理治疗领域的应用正在快速发展，能有效减轻行政负担、优化文档和计费流程。你需要主动了解并适应 AI 技术，但不必立即成为专家，重点是探索其在实践中提高效率和改善患者护理的实用性。
items.titleZh: 探索人工智能对物理治疗师执业和支付的影响 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日举行播客讨论，探讨人工智能 (AI) 对物理治疗师执业和支付的快速影响。讨论内容涵盖 AI 如何减少行政负担、改进文件和计费流程、识别支付趋势，并帮助临床医生更专注于患者护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This APTA discussion reminds you that AI applications in physical therapy are rapidly evolving, effectively reducing administrative burden and optimizing documentation and billing workflows. You need to proactively understand and adapt to AI technology, but not necessarily become an expert overnight; the focus is on exploring its practical utility in improving efficiency and patient care.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) Accreditation Committee published its "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation" on October 16, 2026. These principles aim to guide accreditation authorities in adopting outcome-based approaches to health practitioner education, fostering flexibility and innovation, and supporting education delivery in underserved locations to address workforce challenges in Australia.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 发布了“基于结果的认证方法原则”，这标志着澳大利亚医疗专业教育认证的重大转变。这些原则旨在促进灵活和创新的教育模式，尤其支持在农村和偏远地区提供教育，这将直接影响 PT 教育和劳动力供应，对执业范围和远程医疗政策也可能产生间接影响。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构——基于结果的认证方法使用原则
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 认证委员会于 2026 年 10 月 16 日发布了“基于结果的认证方法使用原则”。这些原则旨在指导认证机构在健康从业者教育中采用基于结果的方法，促进灵活性和创新，并支持在澳大利亚医疗服务不足地区提供教育，以解决劳动力挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has published "Principles for the use of outcome-based approaches to accreditation," marking a significant shift in health professional education accreditation in Australia. These principles aim to promote flexible and innovative educational models, particularly supporting education delivery in rural and remote areas, which will directly impact PT education and workforce supply, with potential indirect effects on scope of practice and telehealth policies.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes after stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes within the UK matched care model. It targets stroke survivors with mild to moderate cognitive changes, low mood, anxiety, and fatigue through personalized psychoeducation and three brief reviews at 1, 3, and 6 months.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目旨在填补英国卒中后心理支持的空白，特别是针对轻中度认知、情绪、焦虑和疲劳变化的患者。它通过监测症状、提供个性化心理教育和支持自我管理，为早期干预提供了潜在的标准化路径。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化的强化评估（ENRICH）项目开发：在匹配护理模式中监测和支持卒中后心理变化自我管理的复杂干预措施
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化的强化评估（ENRICH）项目是一个旨在英国匹配护理模式中监测和支持卒中后心理变化自我管理的简短干预。它通过个性化心理教育和在第 1、3、6 个月的三次简短评估，为有轻中度认知变化、情绪低落、焦虑和疲劳的卒中幸存者提供支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program aims to fill gaps in UK post-stroke psychological support, particularly for patients with mild to moderate cognitive, mood, anxiety, and fatigue changes. It offers a potential standardized pathway for early intervention by monitoring symptoms, providing personalized psychoeducation, and supporting self-management.
items.limitation: 本研究描述的是干预措施的设计和开发，其临床有效性和可行性尚待未来试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This study describes the design and development of an intervention, and its clinical effectiveness and feasibility are yet to be validated in future trials.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: A review of anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) highlights shifts in graft utilization (quadriceps tendon autograft now ~20%), support for lateral extra-articular tenodesis in high-risk knees, and a move towards criteria-based return-to-play. It emphasizes combining time from surgery, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, noting that limb symmetry index may overestimate recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提醒我们 ACL 重建后的返场和再损伤率在过去二十年没有显著改善。在选择移植材料、考虑侧方加强以及制定返场标准时，需要综合考虑时间、功能测试和心理准备，而非单一依赖某个因素。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植材料选择、侧方加强、康复与返场
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于前交叉韧带重建 (ACLR) 的综述指出，移植材料使用（股四头肌腱自体移植物现约占 20%）和高危膝关节侧方关节外腱固定术的采用有所增加，同时返场策略转向基于标准。综述强调，返场决策应综合考虑术后时间、功能标准和心理准备，并指出肢体对称指数可能高估功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review reminds us that return-to-play and reinjury rates after ACL reconstruction have not significantly improved in the past two decades. Graft selection, lateral augmentation, and return-to-play criteria should integrate time from surgery, functional testing, and psychological readiness, rather than relying on a single factor.
items.limitation: 本综述的局限性在于其叙述性，未进行系统性证据合成，可能存在选择偏倚和信息更新滞后。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this review is its narrative nature, lacking systematic evidence synthesis, which may lead to selection bias and outdated information.

items.title: The effect of adding virtual reality-based rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy on pain, function and static balance control in patients with total knee arthroplasty during the acute rehabilitation phase: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=52) found that adding virtual reality (VR)-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved WOMAC scores and pain (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36) at post-treatment and 1-month follow-up in patients after total knee arthroplasty. Static balance also improved, with greater reductions in COP ellipse area and mediolateral mean velocity (p < 0.001; η² = 0.23) in the VR group.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术后的早期康复，将 VR 疗法整合到传统物理治疗中，可以带来疼痛、功能和平衡的额外短期益处，特别是静态平衡。这提示 VR 技术在 TKA 康复中具有潜力，但需要更大规模的试验来确证。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术急性康复期将虚拟现实疗法加入常规物理治疗对疼痛、功能和静态平衡控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=52）发现，在全膝关节置换术后，将虚拟现实（VR）疗法添加到常规物理治疗中，能显著改善患者在治疗后和 1 个月随访时的 WOMAC 评分和疼痛（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36）。静态平衡也有所改善，VR 组在 COP 椭圆面积和内侧向平均速度方面有更大程度的降低（p < 0.001; η² = 0.23）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating VR therapy into conventional physical therapy during early rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty may offer additional short-term benefits for pain, function, and balance, especially static balance. This suggests the potential of VR technology in TKA rehabilitation, but larger trials are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（52 名患者），随访时间较短（1 个月），且是单中心研究，可能限制结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (52 patients), short follow-up (1 month), and is single-center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Promoting arm movement practice with a novel wheelchair armrest early after stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=35) evaluated the Boost wheelchair-mounted device for upper extremity (UE) motor recovery early after stroke. Participants in the Boost group completed 3,359 ± 3,137 arm movements. While no significant between-group clinical differences were found at 3-month follow-up, the Boost group showed a trend toward greater UEFM improvement immediately post-intervention (11.8 vs. 6.9 points, p = 0.06), especially for those with less severe impairment (UEFM > 21) at discharge (15.8 vs. 7.8 points, p = 0.01).
items.curatedReason: Boost 轮椅扶手这种新颖的康复设备，在卒中早期住院康复阶段，显示出促进患臂运动练习的可行性，并可能对轻度受损患者有短期益处。虽然尚未显示出显著的组间临床差异，但其在无需直接监督下实现大量练习的潜力值得关注。
items.titleZh: 在卒中早期使用新型轮椅扶手促进患臂运动练习：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=35）评估了 Boost 轮椅扶手设备在卒中早期上肢运动恢复中的效果。Boost 组的参与者完成了 3,359 ± 3,137 次手臂运动。虽然在 3 个月随访时未发现显著的组间临床差异，但 Boost 组在干预后即刻的 UEFM 改善趋势更大（11.8 vs. 6.9 分, p = 0.06），特别是对于出院时损伤较轻的患者（UEFM > 21）（15.8 vs. 7.8 分, p = 0.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For early post-stroke upper extremity recovery, the Boost wheelchair device shows promise as an adjunct, enabling a high volume of unsupervised arm movements (average 3359). While no significant clinical differences were seen at 3 months, the Boost group, particularly those with less severe impairment (UEFM > 21), showed a stronger trend toward immediate post-intervention improvement (15.8 vs. 7.8 points, p=0.01). This device offers increased practice opportunities worth considering.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步探索性 RCT，样本量较小（35 名卒中住院患者），随访期短，且未显示显著的组间临床差异，需大规模试验验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary, exploratory RCT with a small sample size (35 stroke inpatients) and short follow-up, showing no significant between-group clinical differences. Larger trials are needed for validation.

items.title: Geriatric interdisciplinary intermediate care after hip fracture: associations with immobility and recurrent falls
items.summary: A retrospective observational cohort study of 205 hip fracture patients found that those receiving Geriatric Interdisciplinary Intermediate Care (GIMC) had lower observed immobility (17.0% vs. 32.7%) and fewer recurrent falls (1.1% vs. 5.2%) at one-year follow-up compared to usual care. GIMC patients were also more likely to be ambulatory (82.0% vs. 67.3%).
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究表明，老年综合跨学科中间护理（GIMC）可能与髋部骨折老年患者的较低不动性和较少复发性跌倒相关。这强调了多学科协作和家庭康复在老年患者术后管理中的价值，鼓励你在实践中积极推动和参与此类综合护理模式。
items.titleZh: 髋部骨折后老年综合跨学科中间护理：与不动性和复发性跌倒的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 205 名髋部骨折患者的回顾性观察队列研究发现，与常规护理相比，接受老年综合跨学科中间护理（GIMC）的患者在一年随访时观察到的不动性较低（17.0% vs. 32.7%），复发性跌倒也较少（1.1% vs. 5.2%）。GIMC 患者也更有可能恢复行走能力（82.0% vs. 67.3%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that Geriatric Interdisciplinary Intermediate Care (GIMC) may be associated with lower immobility and fewer recurrent falls in older adults after hip fracture. This highlights the value of multidisciplinary collaboration and home-based rehabilitation in post-operative management of elderly patients, encouraging you to actively promote and participate in such integrated care models.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察队列研究，可能存在混杂因素和选择偏倚，导致无法建立明确的因果关系，且结果的普遍性可能受限于单中心数据。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective observational cohort study may be subject to confounding factors and selection bias, preventing the establishment of clear causal relationships, and the generalizability of results may be limited by single-center data.

items.title: Effects of resistance training intensity and a dietary protein intervention on psychosocial outcomes, executive function, and quality of life in frail community-dwelling older adults
items.summary: A secondary analysis of the TEAMS RCT (n=295 frail older adults) found that 12 weeks of supervised resistance training to volitional muscular failure reduced depressive symptoms (β = −0.167), improved executive function (TMT-A β = −4.71 s; TMT-B β = −12.11 s; SCWT log β = −0.091; LF β = +2.46 words), and enhanced quality of life (β = +1.26). Training intensity did not consistently influence these changes. A dietary protein intervention led to a greater reduction in fear of falling (log β = −0.257) but no consistent additional benefits for other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对衰弱社区老年人进行 12 周监督阻力训练，可改善抑郁症状、执行功能和生活质量，且训练强度似乎不是主要影响因素。虽然蛋白质干预对跌倒恐惧有额外益处，但整体效果不一致。这意味着你在为这类患者制定康复计划时，应优先考虑坚持阻力训练本身，并可考虑将蛋白质补充作为辅助。
items.titleZh: 阻力训练强度和膳食蛋白质干预对衰弱社区老年人心理社会结局、执行功能和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 随机对照试验（n=295 名衰弱老年人）的二次分析发现，12 周监督下的力竭阻力训练可减轻抑郁症状（β = −0.167），改善执行功能（TMT-A β = −4.71 秒；TMT-B β = −12.11 秒；SCWT log β = −0.091；LF β = +2.46 词），并提高生活质量（β = +1.26）。训练强度并未持续影响这些变化。膳食蛋白质干预导致跌倒恐惧症更大幅度下降（log β = −0.257），但对其他结局没有持续的额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that 12 weeks of supervised resistance training for frail community-dwelling older adults can improve depressive symptoms, executive function, and quality of life, with training intensity not appearing to be a major influencing factor. While protein intervention showed additional benefits for fear of falling, the overall effect was inconsistent. This means when designing rehabilitation plans for such patients, you should prioritize adherence to resistance training itself, and consider protein supplementation as an adjunct.
items.limitation: 本研究是随机对照试验的二次分析，并非主要结局，且训练强度和蛋白质干预的额外益处并不一致，需要前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis of an RCT, not the primary outcome, and the additional benefits of training intensity and protein intervention were inconsistent, requiring prospective validation.

items.title: Effect of lumbar strengthening exercises on kinesiophobia in people with chronic low back pain: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 3 RCTs found inconsistent evidence regarding the effectiveness of lumbar strengthening exercises in reducing kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic low back pain. While one trial reported significant reductions with isokinetic trunk strengthening compared to core stabilization and conventional exercise, two found no significant differences. The overall certainty of evidence was graded as very low.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调，目前关于腰部强化训练能否有效降低慢性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症的证据非常有限且质量较低。在常规临床实践中，你不应过度依赖单一的腰部强化训练来解决运动恐惧症，而应结合多模式干预。
items.titleZh: 腰部强化训练对慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧症的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3 项随机对照试验的系统综述发现，关于腰部强化训练能否有效减少慢性腰痛患者运动恐惧症的证据不一致。尽管一项试验报告等速躯干强化训练相较于核心稳定和常规运动能显著降低运动恐惧症，但另两项试验未发现显著差异。总体证据确定性被评定为非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that current evidence on whether lumbar strengthening exercises effectively reduce kinesiophobia in chronic low back pain patients is very limited and of low quality. In routine clinical practice, you should not over-rely on solitary lumbar strengthening to address kinesiophobia, but rather integrate multimodal interventions.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入了 3 项研究，证据确定性非常低，且研究间干预措施和对照组差异较大，限制了结论的通用性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only 3 studies, with very low certainty of evidence and considerable heterogeneity in interventions and control groups, limiting the generalizability of the conclusions.

items.title: Intermittent theta burst stimulation on the cerebellar Hemisphere to imprOve Post-stroke cognitivE impairment (HOPE): a multicentre randomised controlled double-blind trial
items.summary: The HOPE trial is a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled study designed to investigate the safety and efficacy of intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) on the contralesional cerebellar hemisphere to improve cognitive function in 70 adults with cognitive impairment within 14 days after a first-ever unilateral supratentorial ischaemic stroke. Participants will receive 7 consecutive days of stimulation and be followed for 180 days, with the primary efficacy outcome being Montreal Cognitive Assessment score change at day 90±7.
items.curatedReason: HOPE 试验旨在探索小脑间歇性 θ 爆发刺激（iTBS）对早期卒中后认知障碍（PSCI）的安全性与疗效。如果结果积极，它可能为卒中康复提供一种新的认知神经调控策略，但目前仍是协议阶段，期待最终结果。
items.titleZh: 小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激改善卒中后认知障碍（HOPE）的安全性与疗效：一项多中心随机对照双盲试验
items.summaryZh: HOPE 试验是一项多中心、随机、双盲、假对照研究，旨在评估对侧小脑半球间歇性 θ 爆发刺激（iTBS）对 70 名首次单侧幕上缺血性卒中后 14 天内出现认知障碍成人认知功能的安全性与有效性。参与者将接受连续 7 天的刺激，并随访 180 天，主要疗效指标为第 90±7 天蒙特利尔认知评估评分的变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The HOPE trial aims to explore the safety and efficacy of cerebellar intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) for early post-stroke cognitive impairment (PSCI). If positive, it could offer a new cognitive neuromodulation strategy for stroke rehabilitation, but it is currently in the protocol stage, awaiting final results.
items.limitation: 本研究目前仅是试验方案，尚未产出临床数据，因此无法评估其有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study is currently only a trial protocol, with no clinical data yet, so its effectiveness and safety cannot be evaluated.

items.title: Effects of training with a soft wearable robot (Myosuit®) on the walking ability of patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: A randomized controlled study (n=30) on chronic stroke patients found no significant overall difference between gait training with Myosuit® soft wearable robot and a control group. However, subgroup analysis showed that Myosuit® group patients with FAC 4 (Functional Ambulatory Category scale) achieved significant improvements in the 10-m walking test, Berg Balance Scale, and gait velocity.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究表明，Myosuit® 软性可穿戴机器人在慢性卒中患者的步态训练中，可能对步态功能较好的患者有改善作用，例如 FAC 4 级患者在 10 米步行测试和 Berg 平衡量表上有所提升。对于这类患者，你可以考虑将这类辅助机器人纳入康复方案。
items.titleZh: 使用软性可穿戴机器人（Myosuit®）训练对慢性卒中患者步行能力的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对慢性卒中患者进行的随机对照研究（n=30）发现，使用 Myosuit® 软性可穿戴机器人进行步态训练与对照组之间总体上无显著差异。然而，亚组分析显示，功能性步行分类（FAC）为 4 级的 Myosuit® 组患者在 10 米步行测试、Berg 平衡量表和步速方面均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study suggests that Myosuit® soft wearable robot gait training may improve gait function in chronic stroke patients with better gait function, for example, FAC 4 patients showed improvements in the 10-meter walk test and Berg Balance Scale. For such patients, you might consider incorporating this type of assistive robot into rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（30 名患者），且主要结果在两组间无显著差异，仅在亚组分析中显示出益处，需要更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (30 patients), and the primary results showed no significant differences between groups; benefits were only observed in subgroup analysis, requiring validation by larger studies.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial of 148 participants found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4) and disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9) compared to sham PBMT plus MCE for chronic non-specific low back pain over 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 148 名受试者的 RCT 表明，对慢性非特异性下腰痛患者，光生物调节疗法 (PBMT) 对运动控制训练 (MCE) 的额外益处可忽略不计。别再用 PBMT 作为常规辅助，证据不支持。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练的辅助手段，对慢性非特异性下腰痛患者的疗效可忽略不计：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 148 名参与者的随机对照试验发现，对于慢性非特异性下腰痛患者，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法 (PBMT)，与假 PBMT 加 MCE 相比，在疼痛强度（MD -0.4 分，95% CI -1.2 至 0.4）和残疾（MD -0.7 分，95% CI -2.4 至 0.9）方面提供的额外改善可忽略不计，且在 12 个月的随访期内无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT with 148 participants shows that photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) offers negligible additional benefits to motor control exercise (MCE) for chronic non-specific low back pain. Reconsider PBMT as a routine adjunct; the evidence doesn't support it.
items.limitation: 该研究关注慢性非特异性腰痛人群，结果对其他类型或急性腰痛的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on chronic non-specific low back pain, limiting generalizability to other types or acute low back pain.

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 25 RCTs (1,540 participants) found that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise are effective in reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders. Multimodal treatments, particularly combining dry needling and manual therapy, appeared to be the most effective approach.
items.curatedReason: 这项对颞下颌关节紊乱病 (TMD) 的 NMA 证实，手法治疗和治疗性运动是有效的止痛策略，应作为一线干预。多模式治疗（特别是干针与手法治疗结合）看起来最有效，值得你在临床实践中优先考虑。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱病患者疼痛方面的疗效：一项系统综述与网络 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项随机临床试验（共 1540 人）的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析发现，手法治疗和治疗性运动在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱病患者的疼痛方面是有效的。多模式治疗，特别是干针与手法治疗的结合，似乎是最有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This NMA on temporomandibular disorders (TMD) confirms that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise are effective pain-reducing strategies and should be first-line interventions. Multimodal treatments, especially the combination of dry needling and manual therapy, appear most effective and should be prioritized in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的异质性和方法学质量差异可能影响网络 Meta 分析的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Variability in heterogeneity and methodological quality of included studies may affect the certainty of the network meta-analysis.

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: A prospective study of patients found that physical quality of life improved progressively over 3 months, while mental quality of life improved only in the first month. Ambulation and depressive symptoms were independently associated with changes in physical and mental quality of life, respectively.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究指出，卒中后前 3 个月内，躯体和心理生活质量恢复轨迹不同。规划早期康复时，必须同时关注步态能力和抑郁症状，别只盯着躯体功能。
items.titleZh: 卒中后生活质量的早期变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对患者的前瞻性研究发现，卒中后前 3 个月内，躯体生活质量持续改善，而心理生活质量仅在第一个月有所改善。步态能力与躯体生活质量变化独立相关，而抑郁症状与心理生活质量变化独立相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study highlights divergent recovery trajectories for physical and psychosocial quality of life in the first 3 months post-stroke. When planning early rehabilitation, you must address both ambulation and depressive symptoms, not just physical function.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于首次卒中患者，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small sample size and restriction to first-ever stroke patients may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: A narrative review highlights recent pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research, revealing its expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, the emergence of alternative delivery models, and growing evidence for its economic benefits. Challenges remain in access and maintaining benefits post-PR.
items.curatedReason: 这篇叙述性综述总结了肺康复的最新进展，证实了其有效性已超越稳定期 COPD，扩展至多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并涌现了多样化的交付模式。肺康复的适用范围和实施方式都在拓宽，是时候重新评估你在诊所能覆盖哪些新适应症了。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述强调了肺康复（PR）的最新研究进展，揭示其范围已从稳定期慢阻肺扩展到多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，出现了替代性的交付模式，并有越来越多的证据支持其经济效益。但肺康复的普及性和维持康复效果仍是挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review summarizes recent advances in pulmonary rehabilitation, confirming its effectiveness beyond stable COPD to a range of chronic respiratory diseases, and highlights emerging diverse delivery models.
